subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should core permanently replace Node glob with an OpenClaw-owned cooperative bootstrap walker and yield between all bootstrap hook handlers to protect gateway responsiveness?
rationale: The patch is technically focused and has useful real behavior evidence, but it changes long-lived compatibility and timing contracts that source review alone cannot calibrate without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the core contract
options.body: Approve the cooperative walker and bootstrap-only hook yields, then require a fresh rebase and exact-head validation before merge.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep asynchronous root-file reads and timing diagnostics, but retain Node glob or remove hook scheduling changes until a separately owned compatibility design exists.

options.title: Pause for a dedicated design
options.body: Defer the PR until maintainers define the supported glob and hook-scheduling semantics for bootstrap context.

recommendation.title: Accept the core contract
recommendation.body: Approve the cooperative walker and bootstrap-only hook yields, then require a fresh rebase and exact-head validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR was explicitly routed to this core decision area, and the remaining choice is product/runtime contract ownership rather than a mechanical contributor repair.
